title: Celebrating 20 years of Leaders in Oncology Care

shots.description: Close-up of a gloved lab worker loading blood sample tubes into a StatSpin benchtop centrifuge and closing the lid in a pathology lab.
Close-up of a benchtop centrifuge spinning sample tubes in a laboratory, seen through the clear lid with a yellow warning triangle on the front.

Drone shot over a London street junction at golden hour, moving past autumn trees toward a red-brick Victorian building flanked by modern glass-fronted blocks, with buses and cars passing below and the city skyline behind.

Aerial drone view over a London junction with autumn trees in the foreground, a red double-decker bus and traffic on the road, and a red-brick Victorian building among modern apartment blocks, with the city skyline and cranes beyond.

Drone shot moving over a London street at a road junction with a blue cycle lane, showing a red-brick Victorian building with turrets between modern glass-fronted blocks, with trees in the foreground and the city skyline behind. No signage confirms which building is Leaders in Oncology Care.

Aerial drone shot moving toward a red-brick Victorian building with corner turrets on a central London street, surrounded by modern glass-fronted blocks, rooftops and autumn trees under evening light. Cars are parked and driving along the street below, with the city skyline and cranes in the distance.

Aerial drone shot over central London on an autumn evening, looking across red-brick and modern office buildings beside a tree-lined park. Red double-decker buses and cyclists move through a junction with blue cycle lanes below.

Aerial drone shot over a London road junction with blue cycle lanes, traffic and trees in autumn colours, with a red-brick Victorian building with turrets and modern office blocks behind. Used as a city establishing shot; no hospital building or signage is identifiable.

Aerial drone view of a London street junction with a red brick Victorian building with turrets, modern glass apartment blocks, autumn trees and a blue cycle lane, as traffic moves through the junction. No hospital signage is visible.

Aerial drone shot moving slowly over a tree-lined London street with red-brick Victorian mansion blocks beside modern glass and brick apartment buildings, early morning light. Cars are parked and moving along the road below; no hospital signage is visible.

Aerial drone shot moving slowly over a London residential neighbourhood, showing a curved red-brick apartment block with green roof terraces, surrounding terraced houses and taller buildings behind. No hospital building or signage is identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot over a London residential area, moving from a curved brick apartment block with a planted roof toward the River Thames, a railway bridge and a riverside road with traffic. No hospital building or signage is identifiable.

Drone shot over the River Thames in London, moving across a riverside road with blue cycle lanes and red-brick mansion blocks, as red double-decker buses cross a white suspension bridge (appears to be Chelsea Bridge) with a railway bridge behind. Early morning or evening light, no hospital building or signage visible.

Aerial drone shot over a London street and park in autumn, moving toward the River Thames, with traffic, including a red double-decker bus, crossing a white suspension bridge and a railway bridge behind it. Red-brick mansion blocks line the road at golden hour.

Aerial drone shot at golden hour over a London riverside road junction with red-brick mansion blocks and autumn trees, looking out to bridges over the River Thames as traffic moves along the embankment. A general London establishing shot with no hospital building or signage in view.

Drone shot at sunset over Chelsea, London, looking across the River Thames toward Chelsea Bridge, the Grosvenor railway bridge and Battersea Power Station, with red-brick mansion blocks and traffic on the Embankment in the foreground. A London establishing shot with no hospital or HCA signage visible.

Aerial drone view at sunset over Chelsea and the River Thames in London, looking towards Battersea Power Station and the Nine Elms skyline, with traffic crossing Chelsea Bridge and the Grosvenor railway bridge behind it. Red-brick mansion blocks and autumn trees line the embankment in the foreground.

Aerial drone shot over Chelsea at sunset, looking across the River Thames towards Battersea Power Station, with traffic crossing Chelsea Bridge and red-brick mansion blocks and autumn trees in the foreground. A London establishing shot with no hospital building or signage visible.

Drone shot over the River Thames at sunset, moving along Chelsea Bridge with traffic crossing, Grosvenor railway bridge behind and Battersea Power Station's chimneys on the skyline. Works as a London establishing shot; no hospital building is shown.

Aerial drone shot over the River Thames in London at golden hour, showing an arched bridge, traffic on a riverside road and city towers on the skyline. A general London establishing cutaway with no hospital building or signage in view.

Aerial drone shot over the River Thames in London at sunrise or sunset, looking across the Grosvenor railway bridge towards Battersea Power Station and the Nine Elms skyline. Barges sit on the river and traffic moves along the road on the Chelsea bank.

Aerial drone shot at golden hour over London apartment blocks and a road running beside the River Thames, with a railway bridge crossing the river and the city skyline silhouetted against the low sun. The camera drifts slowly across the rooftops toward the river.

Drone shot over red-brick buildings and a road beside the River Thames at sunset, moving slowly towards a railway bridge with the London skyline in the distance. Traffic is moving along the road below.

Aerial drone shot at sunset over residential apartment blocks beside the River Thames in London, with a railway bridge crossing the river and the city skyline in the distance. Traffic moves along a tree-lined road next to the water.
Aerial drone shot at sunset moving towards the River Thames over residential blocks, a brick chimney tower, a busy road and a railway bridge, with the London skyline in the distance.

A bearded man in glasses and a dark suit, wearing a lapel microphone, speaks to camera in a clinical room with a hand wash sink behind him at Leaders in Oncology Care. Interview-style piece to camera for the 20-year anniversary film.
